options.name: endpoint
options.description: Endpoint to use to connect to API. Do not change until specifically asked to do otherwise. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: fingerprint
options.description: Fingerprint of the key. Used for I(state)=C(absent). If both I(fingerprint) and I(public_keys) are given, module returns error if they are from different keys. Derived automatically from I(public_key) if needed.

options.name: labels
options.description: Labels to attach to the key. Used for I(state)=C(present). If not specified, no labels will be attached.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the key. Required for I(state)=C(present). Used for I(state)=C(absent) to remove keys by name.

options.name: public_key
options.description: public key in base64 (with type prefix, f.e. ssh-rss). Used to calculate I(fingerprint). Required for I(state)=C(present).

options.name: replace
options.description: Used for I(state)=C(present). If set to C(false), module fails if other keys with the same name or fingerprint are present. If set to C(true), remove conflicting keys.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the key. If I(state)=C(present), module checks if there are other keys with the same name or fingerprint. If they are but are different (f.e. existing key with a given nave have different fingerprint) they are replaced with I(name) and I(public_key) values. If I(state)=C(absent), module removes keys based both on name and fingerprint or fail if I(replace) is C(false).

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use. You can create token for your account in https://portal.servers.com in Profile -> Public API section. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) or C(SC_TOKEN) environment variable is used (C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) takes precedence). Value is not logged.
